reviews.title: My daughter LOVES this
reviews.body: I put off buying it because I wasn't sure of size or sturdiness. However, my four year old fits in the ball pit laying down, and she is tall for her age. She can also stand up in the tent, which was amazing. The tent poles are actual camping poles, nice and sturdy made of super hard material and metal. Like I am 5'7 and can sit inside the tent with her, little snug but doable. I also can sit in the ball pit with her, little snug. Just for size reference. We bought one of those star ball packs off here(50 small balls and 50 small stars) and five 100 ball packs, which fill the ball pit nicely. The balls roll down the tunnel into the tent, but that's fine in my opinion. Amazing buy, 100 percent RECOMMENDED. Good size overall, super sturdy, only complaint is how they connect. The tunnel connects only at two spots, which don't hold very well. I shove the tube into the pit and tent a little. Maybe if there was more connection points it would be better for holding the balls, but it is super easy to take down and put back up. Easy to move, very light if the balls aren't in it. :) GOOD BUY MY DAUGHTER LIVES IN THIS NOW. I can't get her out of it. And my cats enjoy it too. Haha.

reviews.title: Fun Design but Some Minor Drawbacks
reviews.body: This kids ball pit play tent set has a really cute rocket ship and space theme that my child absolutely loved. The pop-up design makes setup quick, and the tunnel adds a fun interactive element that keeps kids entertained and active.That said, the material feels a bit lightweight, so it doesn’t always hold its shape perfectly during energetic play. It works well for casual indoor use, but for rougher play or frequent setup and takedown, durability could be better. I also wish it came with a storage bag that was easier to use.Overall, it’s a fun and engaging play set that sparks imagination and works great for lighter play sessions. With slightly sturdier materials, it would be even better — but it still provides plenty of entertainment for toddlers.
